# Attachment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Attachment`](gmeow-Attachment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Attachment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

A non-inline body part presented as an attached file. An attachment may also be a [`gmeow:Document`](gmeow-Document.md) or [`gmeow:MediaObject`](gmeow-MediaObject.md) (the two are not disjoint), and its text extraction or summary is a derived object linked by [`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](../properties/gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:BodyPart`](gmeow-BodyPart.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Attachment`](gmeow-Attachment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:BodyPart`](gmeow-BodyPart.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
